ja203:1.1: I am friendly with the Virūpakkhas,
ja203:1.2: with the Erāpathas I am friendly,
ja203:1.3: I am friendly with the Chabyāputtas,
ja203:2.1: I’m friendly with those without feet,
ja203:2.2: with those with two feet I’m friendly,
ja203:2.3: I’m friendly with those with four feet,
ja203:2.4: with those with many feet I’m friendly.
ja203:3.1: May the one without feet not hurt me,
ja203:3.2: may the one with two feet not hurt me,
ja203:3.3: May the one with four feet not hurt me,
ja203:3.4: may the one with many feet not hurt me.
ja203:4.1: May all beings, all living creatures, all beings entirely,
ja203:4.4: may nothing bad come to anyone.
